how_to_apply: Log in to https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings, scroll down and click on the respective advertisement.
Download Advertisement No. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/36 and click Apply Online.
Upload your photograph and signature first; the online application will not be registered without them.
Upload the documents listed below. A provisional registration number and password is generated when you save; saved information can be edited three times only.
Submit the completed application and pay the fee through the payment gateway using Debit Card/ Credit Card/ Internet Banking. No change is allowed after payment.
Print and retain the e-receipt and application form generated after successful payment.

Registration is complete only when the fee is paid online on or before 3 December 2026. The fee is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted for any other selection. Do not send a hard copy of the application or documents.
Recent photograph (JPG/JPEG, 20-50 kb, 200 x 230 pixels preferred) and signature (black ink on white paper, 10-20 kb, 140 x 60 pixels preferred; capital letters not accepted)
Brief resume, ID proof and proof of date of birth
PwBD certification (if applicable); caste certificate for fee-exempted SC/ST/PwBD candidates
Educational certificates: relevant mark-sheets/degree certificate; preferred certifications
Form-16/Offer Letter/Latest salary slip from current employer; Form-16/ITR and latest 3 months' salary slips along with CTC form
CTC Negotiation form and Biodata form, duly filled, signed and scanned (available on the Bank's career website under the advertisement)
All documents other than photograph and signature must be in PDF, A4 page size, not exceeding 500 kb.
important_instructions: Candidates in Govt./Quasi Govt. offices, PSUs, Nationalized Banks and Financial Institutions should submit a No Objection Certificate at interview, failing which candidature may not be considered and travel expenses will not be paid. A candidate found ineligible at interview will not be allowed to appear and will not be reimbursed any fare. Candidates with adverse reports regarding character and antecedents or moral turpitude are not eligible to apply. Only the last completed application is retained; fees paid for other registrations are forfeited. Selected candidates must produce a discharge certificate from the employer at joining and be declared medically fit. Details of pending criminal cases must be given at the interview; the Bank may verify police records. The Bank may transfer the officer to any SBI office in India or depute to its associates/subsidiaries; requests for a specific place may not be entertained. Shortlisted/selected lists, revisions and corrigenda will be hosted on https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings only. Legal disputes fall under Mumbai courts only.

content_sections.heading: About SBI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: This recruitment is conducted by the Central Recruitment & Promotion Department of State Bank of India at its Corporate Centre in Mumbai. The post is a Specialist Cadre Officer position on a Fixed Term Employment Basis, and the notice is open to eligible Indian citizens. Enquiries go through the "CONTACT US/ Post Your Query" link on the Bank's careers page; the notice also prints the phone number 022 22820427 and the email [email protected] on its letterhead.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Any one of the following, from a University/ Institution/ Board recognized by Govt. of India/ approved by Govt. Regulatory Bodies (as on 31.10.2026): B. Tech/ B.E. in Computer Science/ Computer Science & Engineering/ Software Engineering/ Information Technology/ Electronics/ Electronics & Communications Engineering/Cyber Security or Equivalent Degree in these disciplines with minimum 50% score; or MCA; or M. Tech/ M. Sc in Computer Science/ Computer Science & Engineering/ Information Technology/ Software Engineering/ Electronics/ Electronics & Communications Engineering/Cyber Security or Equivalent Degree in these disciplines. The notice states that the educational qualification prescribed is the minimum. As on 31.10.2026, the applicant must have at least 15-20 years post qualification experience in Information Technology/ Information Security in Banks/ Large Corporates/ PSUs/ FIs/ Financial Services Organizations/ Financial & Technology Consulting firms, of which minimum 5 years should be in the core domain area of Information Security/Cyber Security/ Cyber Defence in Banks / FIs at Senior Management Level. Training and teaching experience will not be counted for eligibility, and the experience certificate from the employer must specifically state that the candidate had experience in the related field as required. Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) Certified Chief Information Security Officer (CCISO) Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) These certificates should be valid as on the date of interview. Experience in Information Security, Cyber Defence, Security Operations, Enterprise Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance, Security Architecture, Cloud Security, and IT Infrastructure. Experienced in engaging with Board-level stakeholders, regulators, auditors, and executive leadership to strengthen cyber resilience and support secure business growth. Experienced in managing large-scale security transformation programs, leading multidisciplinary teams, overseeing managed security services, implementing AI-driven security operations, and protecting critical financial infrastructure. The age limit is a maximum of 50 years as on 31 October 2026. The notice does not list category-wise relaxations; it says candidates seeking age relaxation must submit copies of the necessary certificates at the time of joining. Candidates of reserved categories may apply against the Unreserved vacancy provided they fulfil all eligibility conditions applicable to the General category. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Annual CTC is negotiable and depends on experience, current emoluments in the present employment and place of posting. CTC will be offered based on industry standards, the candidate's experience and last drawn salary. CTC is split into Fixed Pay and Variable Pay in the ratio 80:20. Besides CTC, no other perks shall be paid. Annual increment from the second year onwards can be up to 10% of the previous year's Annual CTC, subject to a performance appraisal score of at least 90%. Variable pay is payable only on securing a minimum of 90% marks in the performance appraisal; appraisals are held half-yearly as on 31 March and 30 September. If the contract ends before 6 months (from 2nd year onwards), variable pay is released on a pro-rata basis, subject to income tax deduction. Initial contract of 3 years, which may be renewed for a further 2 years at the discretion of the Bank on mutually agreed terms; total period shall not exceed 5 years. The contract can be terminated without assigning reasons by 3 months' notice from either side or on payment/surrender of 3 months' compensation in lieu. Leave of 30 days during the financial year; intervening Sundays/holidays are not counted.

content_sections.heading: SBI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Provide consolidated visibility of observations arising from regulatory reviews, audits, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, red teaming and security incidents. Prioritise risks based on business criticality, exploitability, external exposure, threat intelligence, regulatory implications and potential customer or operational impact. Monitor remediation of critical and high-risk observations and facilitate resolution of cross-functional dependencies and bottlenecks. Promote root-cause analysis and enterprise-wide corrective measures for systemic and recurring deficiencies. Strengthen evidence-based closure through validation, retesting and residual-risk assessment. Oversee improvements in vulnerability, patch, configuration, change, asset, application/API lifecycle and security advisory management. Review the effectiveness and integration of DevSecOps, WAF, ITSAM, vulnerability management, DLP and SIEM platforms. Provide oversight of emerging risks, including AI governance, SBOM/AIBOM maturity, ransomware readiness, backup assurance and digital/payment transaction risks. Establish governance dashboards covering risk trends, ageing, remediation progress, recurring observations and residual risks. Coordinate significant technology and cybersecurity matters with regulators, auditors, consultants and subject-matter experts. Provide strategic oversight of enterprise technology and cybersecurity risks, ensuring visibility, prioritisation and timely escalation. Drive risk-based, systemic remediation of material audit, regulatory, vulnerability and security observations. Oversee effectiveness of critical technology and cybersecurity controls and strengthen assurance mechanisms. Strengthen cyber resilience, ransomware preparedness, recoverability and emerging technology risk governance. Oversee regulatory commitments, security advisories, policy improvements and governance-based exception management. Drive cross-functional accountability for resolution of systemic technology and cybersecurity risks. Lead strategic governance reviews and provide senior management with consolidated risk posture for timely intervention. Key interactions include application owners and GITC departments, ISD, Information Security, infrastructure, business and operational-risk functions, regulators, auditors, external consultants and technology partners. Measures of success include reduced ageing and recurrence of critical observations and timely systemic remediation. The notice says KRAs shall be assigned on joining, the job profile is illustrative, and additional roles may be assigned by the Bank.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SBI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Registration is complete only when the fee is paid online on or before 3 December 2026. The fee is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted for any other selection. Do not send a hard copy of the application or documents. All documents other than photograph and signature must be in PDF, A4 page size, not exceeding 500 kb.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is based on Shortlisting and Interview, followed by CTC Negotiation. Shortlisting: a shortlisting committee of the Bank decides the parameters and calls an adequate number of candidates for interview. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not guarantee a call. Interview: carries 100 marks; qualifying marks will be decided by the Bank. Documents are verified with originals at the interview. Merit list: prepared on interview scores only; candidates with equal marks at the cut-off are ranked by age in descending order. CTC Negotiation: held with candidates one by one in order of merit; a candidate who does not agree is treated as a Voluntary Exit and the next candidate is called. Call letters are sent by email or uploaded on the Bank's website; no hard copy is sent. Outstation candidates called for interview are reimbursed economy class air fare by the shortest route on actual journey; local conveyance is not paid.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for SBI GM & Head-CSTRA?
faq.answer: A B.Tech/B.E. in the specified computer, IT, electronics or cyber security disciplines with minimum 50% score, or MCA, or M.Tech/M.Sc in the specified disciplines, with at least 15-20 years post qualification experience including minimum 5 years in Information Security/Cyber Security/Cyber Defence in Banks/FIs at Senior Management Level.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 750/- for General/EWS/OBC candidates, with no fees/intimation charges for SC/ST/PwBD candidates; it is paid online and is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for SBI Recruitment 2026 for GM & Head-CSTRA?
faq.answer: Apply online through https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings, upload the listed documents in PDF and pay the fee online by 3 December 2026; no hard copy is to be sent.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
